images.title: Multiply coefficients, add exponents
images.purpose: Shows 10⁸ colonies times 5 × 10⁴ bees each giving 5 × 10¹² bees.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Three cards in a row with × and = signs between them.
images.exact_structure: Three white cards in a row: a teal (#0072B2) outlined card reading 10⁸ colonies, a × sign, an amber (#E69F00) outlined card reading 5 × 10⁴ bees, an = sign, and a reddish purple (#CC79A7) outlined card reading 5 × 10¹² bees. Under the cards, centred, the small label 8 + 4 = 12. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame

images.takeaway: Multiplying in scientific notation: multiply the coefficients and add the exponents.
images.description: Shows 10⁸ colonies times 5 × 10⁴ bees each giving 5 × 10¹² bees.
images.context: 100 million = 10 to the power 8; 10 to the power 8 × 5 × 10⁴ = 5 × 10 to the power 12.

image_decisions.why: The practice computes large totals in standard form, and one product shows the method.
